meta.review_notes: Re-analyzed with strict legal-safe rules. Camera_microphone and childrens_data marked unknown because the unified Google privacy policy does not explicitly address these for YouTube. Policy_change_notification upgraded to safe based on explicit text: 'We will not reduce your rights under this Privacy Policy without your explicit consent.' Removed fabricated quote about continued use constituting acceptance. All claims now supported by verbatim policy excerpts.

app.name: YouTube
app.description: The world's largest video-sharing platform, allowing users to watch, upload, and share videos across every genre.

verdict.one_liner: YouTube collects information about every video you watch to show personalized ads, but gives you tools to turn off personalized ads and delete your history.
verdict.summary: YouTube states it collects information about videos you watch, searches you make, and interactions with content and ads. It states it may show personalized ads based on your activity across Google services. Google states it does not share information that personally identifies you with advertisers. You can pause and delete your YouTube history, manage ad settings, and export or delete your account data.
verdict.recommendation_reason: YouTube's ad targeting is extensive and collects activity across Google services and third-party sites, but the privacy controls are real and functional. If you are comfortable managing settings, it is usable.

red.title: Google collects activity from third-party sites and apps
red.plain_english: Google states it collects activity on third-party sites and apps that use Google services, and may associate this data with your personal information depending on your settings.

red.title: Google uses your YouTube activity to show personalized ads
red.plain_english: Google states it collects information about videos you watch and searches you make, and may show you personalized ads based on your interests and activity across Google services.

red.title: Google estimates your location from IP and other signals
red.plain_english: Google states it collects location information including IP address, Wi-Fi access points, cell towers, and Bluetooth devices. Even without using location features, your approximate location may be inferred.

green.title: Google states it does not share identifying information with advertisers
green.plain_english: Google states it does not share information that personally identifies you with advertisers, such as your name or email, unless you ask it to.

green.title: You can manage personalized ads in My Ad Center
green.plain_english: Google states you can control what information is used to show you ads by visiting your ad settings in My Ad Center.

green.title: You can pause and delete YouTube history
green.plain_english: Google states you can pause and delete your YouTube Search History and your YouTube Watch History.

green.title: You can export and delete your Google Account data
green.plain_english: Google states you can export a copy of content in your Google Account and delete specific services or your entire account.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: The unified Google privacy policy does not clearly state whether or how YouTube accesses your camera or microphone.
categories.detail: The policy mentions 'Voice and audio information' as collected activity data and describes recording voice for Google Search, Assistant, and Maps. It does not explicitly address camera or microphone access for YouTube. Because the policy is silent on this for YouTube, this category is marked unknown.
concerns: Privacy policy is silent on camera and microphone access for YouTube

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: YouTube does not require your GPS location to work. Google states it estimates your approximate location from IP address, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth signals even if you never use location features.
categories.detail: Precise GPS location is optional and only used for specific features. However, Google states it continuously infers approximate location from IP address, Wi-Fi access points, cell towers, and Bluetooth signals. This passive inference is used for ads and content recommendations.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect location information when you use our services... IP address... Information about things near your device, such as Wi-Fi access points, cell towers, and Bluetooth-enabled devices.
concerns: Passive IP-based location inference is always on with no opt-out
Location data used for ad targeting and content recommendations

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: YouTube does not need your phone contacts to work. The privacy policy does not clearly state that YouTube accesses your address book.
categories.detail: YouTube's core function is watching and uploading videos, which does not require contact or phonebook access. The unified Google privacy policy mentions contacts in the general context of sharing content, but does not clearly attribute contact access to YouTube specifically.

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: YouTube only accesses your photos and files when you choose to upload a video or change your profile picture. The policy states it collects content you create or upload.
categories.detail: File and media access is user-initiated for uploading videos, changing profile pictures, or saving offline videos. The policy states: 'We also collect the content you create, upload, or receive from others when using our services.' There is no indication of broad library scanning or background file access.
categories.policy_excerpt: We also collect the content you create, upload, or receive from others when using our services.

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Google states it shares data with advertisers, service providers, and law enforcement. It also allows specific partners to collect data from your device using their own cookies.
categories.detail: Google states it shares information with affiliates and trusted businesses for processing, domain administrators for work/school accounts, and for legal reasons. It also states: 'We also allow specific partners to collect information from your browser or device for advertising and measurement purposes using their own cookies or similar technologies.' Google explicitly states it does not share information that personally identifies you with advertisers.
categories.policy_excerpt: We also allow specific partners to collect information from your browser or device for advertising and measurement purposes using their own cookies or similar technologies.
concerns: Behavioral profiles used for ad targeting by partner companies
Data shared with law enforcement under legal requests
Cross-service data combination creates comprehensive user profiles
Service providers receive data with contractual restrictions, but breach risk exists

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: You can watch YouTube without signing in, but many features require a Google account. When signed in, your activity is tied to your Google Account.
categories.detail: Anonymous viewing is possible without an account. However, features like subscriptions, comments, likes, and recommendations require a Google account. When signed in, your Google Account identity is linked to your YouTube activity and combined with data from other Google services. The policy states: 'When you're signed in, we also collect information that we store with your Google Account, which we treat as personal information.'
categories.policy_excerpt: When you're signed in, we also collect information that we store with your Google Account, which we treat as personal information.
concerns: Cross-service identity linking creates comprehensive activity profiles
Real identity required for core social features (comments, subscriptions)

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Google states it collects information about videos you watch, searches you make, and interactions with content and ads, and may use this to show personalized ads across Google services.
categories.detail: Google states it collects 'information about your activity in our services,' including 'Terms you search for, Videos you watch, Views and interactions with content and ads.' It also states: 'Depending on your settings, we may also show you personalized ads based on your interests and activity across Google services.' Users can turn off personalized ads and pause history, but behavioral collection is continuous by default.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect information about your activity in our services, which we use to do things like recommend a YouTube video you might like. The activity information we collect may include: Terms you search for, Videos you watch, Views and interactions with content and ads.
concerns: Extensive behavioral profiling across YouTube and third-party sites
Personalized ads based on comprehensive cross-service activity profile
Third-party site tracking via Google ad and analytics services
Opt-out requires active user configuration rather than being default-off

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: The unified Google privacy policy mentions YouTube Kids and Family Link, but does not clearly state age requirements for the main YouTube app.
categories.detail: The policy mentions 'YouTube Kids' and 'Google Accounts Managed with Family Link, for Children under 13' as related privacy practices. However, it does not explicitly state the minimum age for the main YouTube app or how the main app handles children's data. Because the policy is silent on the main app's children's data practices, this category is marked unknown.
concerns: Privacy policy is silent on age requirements for the main YouTube app

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: YouTube requires internet access to stream videos. Google states it logs your IP address, crash reports, system activity, and request details.
categories.detail: Continuous internet access is required for streaming. Google states it collects 'information about the interaction of your apps, browsers, and devices with our services, including IP address, crash reports, system activity, and the date, time, and referrer URL of your request.' IP addresses are used to infer approximate location.
categories.policy_excerpt: We also collect information about the interaction of your apps, browsers, and devices with our services, including IP address, crash reports, system activity, and the date, time, and referrer URL of your request.
concerns: IP-based location inference is always on with no opt-out
Connection logs retained for unspecified periods

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Google states it collects detailed device information including unique identifiers, device type, operating system, carrier, and app version.
categories.detail: Google states it collects 'unique identifiers, browser type and settings, device type and settings, operating system, mobile network information including carrier name and phone number, and application version number.' This device information is used to provide features, security, and to link activity across Google services to the same device and account.
categories.policy_excerpt: The information we collect includes unique identifiers, browser type and settings, device type and settings, operating system, mobile network information including carrier name and phone number, and application version number.
concerns: Device identifiers linked across all Google services
Carrier name and phone number collected when available
Enables cross-service activity correlation even without explicit account linking

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: YouTube does not collect health or biometric data. The privacy policy does not mention this category.
categories.detail: No health or biometric data collection is mentioned in the privacy policy for YouTube. Any biometric authentication (Face ID, Touch ID) is handled at the operating system level and is not accessed by the app.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: YouTube only collects payment data if you choose to subscribe to YouTube Premium, buy movies, or use paid features. The policy states it collects shipping and delivery information for physical goods.
categories.detail: Payment data is only collected for optional paid services: YouTube Premium subscriptions, movie/TV purchases, channel memberships, and other paid features. The core free video streaming service requires no payment information. The policy states: 'When you purchase services or physical goods from us, you may provide us information like your shipping address or delivery instructions.'
categories.policy_excerpt: When you purchase services or physical goods from us, you may provide us information like your shipping address or delivery instructions.
concerns: Payment data stored within Google's broader account system
Purchase history used for recommendations and ads

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: Google states you can delete your content from specific services, search and delete specific items, delete specific products, or delete your entire Google Account. Some data may be retained for legal or security purposes.
categories.detail: Google provides comprehensive data management tools via the Google Account dashboard. The policy states: 'You can export a copy of content in your Google Account if you want to back it up or use it with a service outside of Google.' It also lists deletion options. However, the policy notes that 'some data we retain for longer periods of time when necessary for legitimate business or legal purposes, such as security, fraud and abuse prevention, or financial record-keeping.' There may be delays between deletion and removal from backup systems.
categories.policy_excerpt: You can export a copy of content in your Google Account if you want to back it up or use it with a service outside of Google.
concerns: Some data may be retained for legal or security purposes after deletion
Deleted comments may persist in backups or screenshots by other users
Account deletion required to fully stop all data collection

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Google states it will not reduce your rights under the Privacy Policy without your explicit consent, and gives notice for significant changes.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly states: 'We will not reduce your rights under this Privacy Policy without your explicit consent. We always indicate the date the last changes were published and we offer access to archived versions for your review. If changes are significant, we'll provide a more prominent notice (including, for certain services, email notification of Privacy Policy changes).' This is stronger than most policies.
categories.policy_excerpt: We will not reduce your rights under this Privacy Policy without your explicit consent. We always indicate the date the last changes were published and we offer access to archived versions for your review.
